Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to
on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If
applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s office during normal business
hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make
inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be
made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours
prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however,
to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a
presentation shall be limited to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council must
fill out a green speaker’s card available at the end of each row in the Chambers. The card permits
the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific
agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City
Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of
items shown on the agenda.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
  March 9, 2010

A regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates was called to order
this day at 6:30 p.m. in the City Council Chambers of City Hall by Mayor Perkins.

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Bird, Rea, Goodhart, Mayor Perkins

ABSENT:  Mayor Pro Tem Humphrey recused

ALSO PRESENT:  City Manager Hoefgen, City Attorney Pannone

CLOSED SESSION: Council recessed to Closed Session at 6:33 p.m.

•  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL -EXISTING LITIGATION
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9 (a)
  Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District v. Palos Verdes Homes Association
  and City of Palos Verdes Estates, Case No. BC431020

RECONVENE: Council reconvened at 7:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Bird, Rea, Goodhart, Mayor Pro Tem Humphrey,
  Mayor Perkins

ALSO PRESENT:  City Manager Hoefgen, City Attorney Pannone, Assistant City
  Manager Smith, Public Work Director Rigg, Police Chief Dreiling,
  City Treasurer Sherwood, Minutes Secretary Monson

MAYOR’S REPORT – Matters of Community Interest

Mayor Perkins provided information on the pending U.S. Census and the importance of each
household’s participation.

Mayor Perkins also announced a free seminar sponsored by Senator Roderick Wright and the PV
Rotary titled “Senior Scam Stopper” to be held March 26th at the Palos Verdes Golf Club.

CONSENT AGENDA

It was moved by Councilmember Goodhart, seconded by Councilmember Bird and unanimously
approved that the following Consent Agenda items be approved:

•  MINUTES OF CITY COUNCIL MEETING OF FEBRUARY 23, 2010

CITY COUNCIL  1
MARCH 9, 2010
 •  CITY TREASURER’S REPORT – FEBRUARY 2010

•  MONTHLY FINANCIAL REPORT – FEBRUARY 2010

•  ADOPT ORDINANCE 10-696; TITLED “AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES AMENDING CHAPTER 9.05 OF THE PALOS
  VERDES ESTATES MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO PICKETING.”

•  AWARD A CONTRACT TO TMC SHOOTING RANGE SPECIALISTS FOR THE
  INSTALLATION OF SOUNDPROOFING MATERIAL IN THE POLICE DEPARTMENT
  SHOOTING RANGE IN THE AMOUNT OF $29.750.00 AND AUTHORIZE THE CITY
  MANAGER TO SIGN THE AGREEMENT

•  APPROVE THE REVISED STANDARD SERVICE AGREEMENT WITH LOS ANGELES
  ANIMAL CARE AND CONTROL FOR ANIMAL CONTROL SERVICES WITHIN THE
  CITY WITH EXPIRATION DATE OF JUNE 30, 2014, AND AUTHORIZE THE CITY
  MANAGER TO SIGN THE AGREEMENT

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

Bill Orton, representative from Senator Roderick Wright’s office, provided additional information on
the “Senior Scam Stopper” seminar to be held on March 26th.

NEW BUSINESS - none

STAFF REPORTS

City Manager’s Report - none

DEMANDS

It was moved by Councilmember Goodhart and seconded by Councilmember Bird that the
demands, as approved by a majority of the City Council, totaling $226,965.67 be allowed and it was
unanimously approved.

It was moved by Councilmember Goodhart and seconded by Councilmember Bird that the
demands, as approved by a majority of the City Council, totaling No. 516885V, 517061H to
517064H, 517075 to 517144 totaling $172,907.84 be allowed and it was unanimously approved.

MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS’ REPORTS

Mayor Perkins thanked the Palos Verdes Peninsula Chamber of Commerce for inviting her to speak at
the Breakfast Mixer held on March 3rd.
CITY COUNCIL  2
MARCH 9, 2010
 Councilmember Goodhart reported on SBCCOG General Assembly that he, Mayor Perkins,
Councilmember Bird, and City Manager Hoefgen attended on February 26.

Councilmember Goodhart reported his attendance at a South Bay Association of Realtors (SBAR)
Open House showcasing a “green” home in Manhattan Beach. The SBAR in cooperation with the
South Bay Environmental Services Center have published a how-to guide to help South Bay residents
make their homes “green”.

Councilmember Goodhart also reported his attendance at the local Disaster District Plan (DDP)
neighborhood meeting in Valmonte held at Julie Patterson’s home.

Councilmember Bird was happy to attend the Police Officers’ Association swearing in of the new
officers. The POA also awarded Jaylin Albao the 2009 PD Employee Recognition Award. He
commended the POA for supporting many local organizations.

Mayor Pro Tem Humphrey reminded residents that the City is still accepting donations toward
purchasing supplies for the Disaster District Plan (DDP) emergency containers that are being placed at
each school site in the City. Residents can contact Community Resource Officer Laurie Slawson for
information.

Mayor Pro Tem Humphrey attended the 30th Anniversary celebration of The Peninsula Seniors at the
Los Verdes Country Club on February 28th where three scholarships were awarded to local students.
This new scholarship program is called Seniors Helping Seniors.

Mayor Pro Tem Humphrey and Councilmember Goodhart attended the California League of Cities Los
Angeles Division General Membership meeting held on March 4th at the Northrop Grumman facility
where the Hornet is assembled.

Councilmember Rea reported on The Friendship Circle organization that is doing great work in the
community. This South Bay chapter of the organization provides social and recreational opportunities
for physically and mentally handicapped teenagers.

CLOSED SESSION: Council recessed to Closed Session at 8:00 p.m.

  •  PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
  Title: City Attorney
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957

Reconvene: Council reconvened at 9:07 p.m. and the Mayor adjourned the meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business before Council the meeting was adjourned at 9:07 p.m. to Monday,
March 22nd, at 1:00 p.m. at the Palos Verdes Golf Club, for the purpose of an Adjourned Regular
Meeting/Closed Session only.

MARCH 9, 2010
